blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives has been pressed to start its investigation of the issues hounding South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative Inc. (Socoteco II), particularly on alleged problems with the plebiscite for its joint venture agreement (JVA) with Ignite Power and Energy Holdings Inc. In a statement, progressive group Bayan Muna party-list and its former representative Carlos Zarate said they have received reports of irregularities, including supposed undue influence exerted by community leaders and the conduct of “proxy voting.” According to Zarate, the House must start its investigation even as Congress has adjourned for a session break. “We are […]...
